headword: {行政|ぎょうせい}{書士|しょし}

definitions.explanation: a licensed professional who prepares and submits documents to government agencies on behalf of clients

examples.japanese: {行政|ぎょうせい}{書士|しょし}にビザの{申請|しんせい}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I asked an administrative scrivener to apply for a visa.

examples.japanese: {行政|ぎょうせい}{書士|しょし}は{許認可|きょにんか}{申請|しんせい}を{代行|だいこう}する。
examples.english: Administrative scriveners handle permit applications on behalf of clients.

examples.japanese: {行政|ぎょうせい}{書士|しょし}に{相談|そうだん}して{書類|しょるい}を{準備|じゅんび}した。
examples.english: I consulted with an administrative scrivener to prepare the documents.

notes:
SCOPE OF WORK:
- {許認可|きょにんか}{申請|しんせい} - permit and license applications
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}{申請|しんせい} - visa/residence status applications
- {建設業|けんせつぎょう}{許可|きょか} - construction business permits
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{登録|とうろく} - vehicle registration
- {契約書|けいやくしょ}{作成|さくせい} - contract drafting

CONTRAST WITH {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし}:
- {行政|ぎょうせい}{書士|しょし} - handles applications to administrative agencies
- {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし} - handles registrations with legal affairs bureaus

JAPAN-SPECIFIC:
Like {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし}, this profession is unique to Japan's legal system.
